purpose: Editorial cases for human or agent evaluation; structural tests do not establish these decisions.

cases.prompt: migrate a column used by two application versions without data loss.
cases.reason: Preserve invariants, compatibility, performance, and recovery when changing persisted data.

cases.prompt: change visual styling without affecting schemas, queries, or persistence.
cases.reason: No responsibility of this domain is affected.

cases.prompt: migrate a column used by two application versions without data loss. The project already has an implementation and evidence of this capability, but no dedicated document.
cases.reason: Inspect evidence, classify coverage, and address only gaps; missing documentation does not mean the domain practice is absent.

cases.prompt: The migration passes on an empty database but has not been exercised against representative existing data.
cases.reason: Compare against the approved criterion outcome; producing a file does not establish that the outcome was achieved.
